scan.description: multi_link_target::shadow_link (a 0.4m box at x=2, closer to the sensor) is in the map system's <ignore_link> list; multi_link_target::real_link (a 1m box at x=3) is not. If ignore_link regresses, shadow_link would occlude real_link and center_value would read ~1.8 (shadow_link's near face) instead of ~2.5 (real_link's near face) -- a tight range around 2.5 is a falsifiable check on the feature itself, not just crash-freedom.

points.description: Finite points should lie on real_link's front face at x=2.5, not shadow_link's at x=1.8.
